label.text: Read-only diagram. Keep the bpmn.io watermark visible.

render-mode.text:
<textarea id="wf-monitor-xml" style="display:none">${monitorBpmnXml!}</textarea>
<textarea id="wf-monitor-activities" style="display:none">${currentActivitiesJson!'[]'}</textarea>
<style>
.highlight:not(.djs-connection) .djs-visual > :nth-child(1) {
  fill: rgba(255, 206, 86, 0.35) !important;
  stroke: #f0ad4e !important;
}
</style>
<link rel="stylesheet" href="/apps/collie-flowable/Asset?file=diagram-js.css"/>
<link rel="stylesheet" href="/apps/collie-flowable/Asset?file=bpmn-js.css"/>
<link rel="stylesheet" href="/apps/collie-flowable/Asset?file=bpmn.css"/>
<link rel="stylesheet" href="/apps/collie-flowable/Asset?file=bpmn-font-fix.css"/>
<script src="/apps/collie-flowable/Asset?file=bpmn-navigated-viewer.production.min.js"></script>
<script>
(function initMonitor() {
  if (typeof BpmnJS === 'undefined') { setTimeout(initMonitor, 80); return; }
  var el = document.getElementById('wf-monitor-canvas');
  if (!el || el.getAttribute('data-wf-ready') === '1') return;
  var xmlEl = document.getElementById('wf-monitor-xml');
  if (!xmlEl) { setTimeout(initMonitor, 80); return; }
  var xml = (xmlEl.value || '').trim();
  if (!xml) return;
  el.setAttribute('data-wf-ready', '1');
  var activities = [];
  try {
    var actEl = document.getElementById('wf-monitor-activities');
    activities = JSON.parse((actEl && actEl.value) || '[]');
  } catch (e) {}
  var viewer = new BpmnJS({ container: el });
  viewer.importXML(xml).then(function () {
    if (!activities || !activities.length) return;
    var registry = viewer.get('elementRegistry');
    var canvas = viewer.get('canvas');
    activities.forEach(function (id) {
      if (registry.get(id)) canvas.addMarker(id, 'highlight');
    });
  }).catch(function (err) { console.error(err); });
})();
</script>
